configurePresets.name: uwp-x64
configurePresets.description: Configures Eden's core stack (common/core/dynarmic/video_core/...) for the Xbox UWP/WindowsStore (AppContainer) target. Desktop frontends are off; dynarmic builds in its W^X + Virtual*FromApp mode. Headless: the Null renderer is chosen at runtime (Vulkan stays compiled). IMPORTANT: run from a 'vcvarsall.bat x64 uwp' shell so cl/link target the Store CRT (see docs/uwp_build.md). The Ninja generator avoids the VS-instance lookup the VS generator requires.

buildPresets.name: uwp-x64
buildPresets.description: Build the Eden core stack for UWP. Add --target <core|dynarmic|common|video_core> to scope.
